scoring.mahalanobis: class-conditional, 8 ISIC classes, shared pooled within-class covariance /(N-K) + 1e-3 I, score = min squared distance (paper standard)
scoring.knn: k=50, L2-normalised features, score = mean Euclidean distance to the 50 neighbours (paper standard)
scoring.fit_split: ISIC train only (16211 images). No domain labels anywhere in the scoring path.

id_sets.lesion_disjoint: ISIC test rows whose lesion_id does not occur in ISIC train or val (2026). Rows with null lesion_id are their own group and are kept (436 of the 2026).

ood_sets: fitzpatrick17k (3887 images, never seen by any branch)

representations.imagenet_resnet50: frozen torchvision IMAGENET1K_V1, fc=Identity, 2048-d, lambda-independent baseline
representations.backbone_raw_lesion: lesion EfficientNet-B3 encoder output before the projector, 1536-d

intervals.imagenet: cluster bootstrap 2000: ID resampled by lesion group, pad_heldout by patient, Fitzpatrick by image (anti-conservative)

decision_rule.stays_high: Mahalanobis AUROC >= 0.90 on BOTH pad_heldout and fitzpatrick17k, against BOTH the full and the lesion-disjoint ID set
decision_rule.knn: reported alongside; does not change the verdict
decision_rule.z_context: secondary only; cannot change the verdict

item2.nearest_centroid: argmin over the 8 class-conditional Mahalanobis distances of the standard score (score not redefined)

criteria_on_primary.C1_nv_fraction_rises: mean NV-nearest fraction of pad_heldout at lambda=0.25 and at lambda=2 each exceeds lambda=0 by more than 2*sqrt(sd_l^2/n_l + sd_0^2/n_0)
criteria_on_primary.C2_inversion_concentrated: at every lambda>0, mean AUROC(NV-nearest OOD vs full ID) < 0.5 AND < mean AUROC(non-NV-nearest OOD vs full ID)
criteria_on_primary.C3_class_matched_distance_shrinks: ratio r = median Mahalanobis distance(OOD -> NV centroid) / median distance(ID test images labelled NV -> NV centroid); mean r at lambda=0.25 and at lambda=2 each below lambda=0 by more than 2*sqrt(sd_l^2/n_l + sd_0^2/n_0)

verdict.some: partial support; name the failing criterion

part_c.object: Table 4 reweighting, Phase 2.5 runB_orth1 features (5 seeds, OOD = pad_full), weights p_PAD(c)/p_ISIC(c)
part_c.decomposition: weighted AUROC = sum_c w_c * AUROC(OOD vs ID class c), w_c = class weight share; exact
part_c.nv_only_counterfactual: change only the NV share from ISIC to PAD level, renormalise the remaining classes in their ISIC proportions
part_c.consistent_in_magnitude_if: the NV-only counterfactual reproduces at least half of the observed drop 0.409 -> 0.240
